tense.system: Binary system: Past (た-form) vs Non-past (る/辞書形).
tense.non_past_hikako: The non-past form covers present habitual action, eternal truths, and future events (明日行く = I will go tomorrow).

te_iru.progressive: With dynamic action verbs, indicates continuous ongoing action (本を読んでいる = is reading a book).
te_iru.resultative_state: With instantaneous change-of-state verbs, indicates the continuing result of a completed action (窓が開いている = the window has opened and is now open; 結婚している = is married).

te_shimau.completion: Action completed thoroughly (本を読んでしまった).
te_shimau.regret_unintentionality: Action happened regretfully or unintentionally (鍵を失くしてしまった).

mood.volitional: Suffix 'よう / う' expressing intention or exhortation (行こう / 食べよう).
mood.potential: Suffix 'れる / られる' or potential verbs expressing ability (書ける / 食べられる).

conditionals.tara: Hypothetical condition and temporal sequence allowing volition in main clause (行ったら教える).
conditionals.ba: Logical hypothetical condition (安ければ買う).
conditionals.to: Automatic natural law / scientific inevitability prohibiting volition (春になると暖かくなる).
conditionals.nara: Topical or advice condition based on interlocutor statement (京都に行くなら新幹線が良い).

passive_reru_rareru.direct_passive: Standard passive where direct object becomes subject (本が読まれる).
passive_reru_rareru.indirect_adversity_passive: Affective/adversity passive where subject suffers harm from an action; has NO English equivalent (雨に降られた = 'I was rained upon [and suffered misfortune]'; 赤ちゃんに泣かれた).

voice.causative_seru_saseru: Making or letting someone perform an action (子供に野菜を食べさせる).
voice.causative_passive_saserareru: Being forced or made to do something against one's preference (無理やり歌わせられた).
